description: Mycelium: inject folder knowledge at session start, capture the session at session end. No-ops when the mycelium CLI isn't installed.

hooks.command: command -v mycelium >/dev/null 2>&1 && mycelium hook session-start 2>/dev/null || true
command -v mycelium >/dev/null 2>&1 && mycelium hook session-end 2>/dev/null || true
